name: @yottameta/yotta-school-doc
description: YuanGong (yotta-school-doc) — a local, deterministic drafting-skeleton and validation skill for school documents. It reads a versioned document-type rule pack plus a structured facts file, builds a reproducible skeleton whose missing facts stay as explicit placeholders, and checks an existing draft for missing fields, structure gaps, date-format and date-order problems, fact-date mismatches, attachment mismatches, unfilled placeholders, student personal data, sensitive wording, overclaims and incomplete meeting action items. Markdown and JSON output, custom rule packs and a CI gate are included. Triggers: drafting a school notice / parents letter / request / report / summary / meeting minutes / plan / briefing skeleton, validating a school document, checking missing fields and dates, reviewing attachments and student-data exposure, or wiring school-document checks into automation. Boundaries: skeleton and deterministic findings only; no fabricated names, dates, numbers, document numbers, policy citations or meeting conclusions; no legal, compliance, inspection or ideological-review conclusion; no replacement for school approval or final issuance; no network access, no model calls, no upload of school drafts or context; no standard text or real school template is bundled. Fully local, zero-dependency (Python 3.8+ standard library).
